note: State park in the wooded Sheyenne River valley. The West Side loop holds the electric sites under trees beside the river; the East Side primitive loop is across the river bridge. Designated horse park with two horse camps and corrals; a homestead house, yurts, a wagon and a cabin for rent. --Claude
summary: Park page + reserveNDparks confirm $15 primitive (East Side gravel 35-50 ft, a 23-ft rig fits) / $25 standard ($30 Sat) 20/30/50-amp with water; 42 non-horse campsites, pads 34-81 ft (max_rig 50 -> 81); flush toilets, showers, dump. Electric 50 added; groups manual; note trimmed. Not waterfront stands with a creekside lead (sites 20B, 22); pin ~240 m from the site centroid.
flags: WATERFRONT: not waterfront stands, but the stored waterfront_evidence ('loops set back ~150m+ across open meadow') is wrong for the West Side loop's river edge: standard site 22 (46.54439,-97.93293) is ~10 m and 20B (46.54416,-97.93309) ~16 m from the Sheyenne through a narrow fringe of trees and brush, and 21/20A ~30-45 m. The channel there is ~20-25 m wide, under the 30 m line, so at most creekside, and a tree fringe screens it: defaults down, no upgrade. East Side primitive 01-06 are 35-60 m from the river through dense woods.

WATER HOOKUP: reserveNDparks posts 'Water Hook-up on Site Yes' on all 21 standard and 4 modern group sites, but the park page footnotes 'electricity & water*' with '*Water hydrant available for filling at the visitor center or dump station.' Written water true from the per-site listing; a reviewer may read the footnote as no water at the site.
COUNT: park page says 16 standard sites; reserveNDparks sells 21 (12-19, 20A, 20B, 21-26 in the south loop plus 32-36 along the west lane). Primitive (10) and group counts agree.

Max length: varied pad lengths (34-81 ft standard, 35-50 ft East Side primitive), not a placeholder. Horse sites all post 70 ft, which looks uniform. Stored sites.pull_through true (derived) is not confirmed or contradicted (no pad type posted); left as is.

BASE: primitive $15 base, weekend surcharge 0 with the Saturday split in fees.note (Graham's Island precedent). POLICY ROW consistent (Saturday +$5 on standard confirmed). Stored reservation_fee 6 / entrance duplicate the state:ND row; left as stored.
